decisions.decision: POST /ui/theme/switch REQUIRES CSRF (Supercharger pattern), not the language switch's no-CSRF exception
decisions.why: LangSwitcher earned the exception by mounting on every page; ThemeSwitcher mounts on one authenticated page, so minting a token is cheap.

decisions.decision: The theme cookie stays but is a READ path only; the write is authenticated-only, so no anonymous POST path exists
decisions.why: Its only job is post-logout continuity — home and login still render the chosen theme.

decisions.decision: ThemeSwitcher mounts only on /settings (not the navbar), and /settings renders the theme control only
decisions.why: Roadmap tier-2 scope column and the ticket title; the owner's standing preference is minimal scope.
Artifact authoring against a fully-decided roadmap; no cross-cutting ambiguity that needed Opus.

decisions.decision: Fold T7.1's gateway.go middleware-registration rename into wave 2's T3, leaving only the two route additions in T7
decisions.why: T3 deletes LanguageMiddleware and T7 is three waves later, so the build would be red across waves 2-4 for one line.

events.event: Tier 2 opened under AUTOPILOT. Artifacts created and validated --strict, then revised after the user settled the CSRF posture (D1) and the cookie's role (D2). 11 tasks, 6 waves from depends_on: [T1,T2] -> [T3,T5,T8,T9] -> [T4] -> [T6] -> [T7,T10] -> [T11].
Wave 1 dispatched: T1+T2 as ONE serial gateway worker (sonnet). Budget at dispatch: five_hour 45%, context 20%, seven_day 27%.

Wave 1 reconciled: T2 done, T1 awaiting-user-verification (tests written, never executed). Leader independently re-ran go build ./... and go vet ./internal/gateway/... (both clean), confirmed the diff is gateway-only, and read catalog.go's diff to confirm all four new keys carry non-empty ES and EN.

WORKER FINDING carried forward to wave 2: tasks.md T1.3 asks for TestNormalizeTheme in ui/theme_test.go, but normalizeTheme is a T3 function that lives in handlers/preferences.go per design.md's file table. The worker tested the equivalent ui.IsSupportedTheme+DefaultTheme composition and documented it rather than faking a call to a function that does not exist yet. T3 must still give handlers.normalizeTheme its own coverage.
Wave 2 dispatched: T3+T5+T8+T9 as ONE serial gateway worker (sonnet). Makefile granted as an extra path for T9 (outside the module sandbox). Budget at dispatch: five_hour 54%, context 22%.

Wave 2 reconciled: T5/T8/T9 done, T3 awaiting-user-verification. Leader independently verified the wave's core constraint by grep: exactly ONE PreferencesFor call site in non-test gateway code (preferences.go:113) and ZERO LanguageFor/ThemeFor calls, so the one-query-per-request guarantee holds. go build + go vet ./... clean repo-wide; make theme-guard exit 0; ui/i18n/boundary guards clean.

LEADER FIX (integration, outside the worker's granted line): gateway.go's doc comment above the middleware still named the deleted handlers.LanguageMiddleware. The worker correctly refused to touch it, having been granted only the one code line. Repointed to PreferencesMiddleware and its one-call contract.

Worker reported it could not give an honest per-task started_at (it never called date at dispatch time) and declined to invent one. The leader's own bracket timestamps stand; only completed_at came from the worker.
